subject: storytime
title: Little Bear words
about: Little Bear and his mother share four small stories: a cold day in the snow, a pot of soup for his birthday, a pretend trip to the moon and a wish at bedtime. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the stories, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read one of the four stories together each night.

book.author: Else Holmelund Minarik
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: Four gentle first stories about a small bear and the mother who always knows what he needs.

cards.note: capital L, it is the first half of his name; tt is one t; le says ul: Lit-ul
capital B, the other half of his name; ear says air here: Bair
capital M, it is Mother Bear's name; o says u; th is one part: Muth-er
s-n blend; ow says long o, like in show
oa says long o, like in boat
all regular; n-t-s at the end
ur says er, like in turn
ir says er; th is one part; ay says long a; two parts: birth + day
magic e makes a say its name
t-r blend; ee says long e
wh says w; a says u here: wut
